verdict.rationale: Temporal is explicitly a code-first, developer-oriented durable execution platform — docs state 'Temporal isn't a no-code Workflow engine — it is Workflows-as-Code' (temporal-docs-11), and workflows are started via SDK Clients or cron-like Schedules, not via pre-built app connectors (Gmail, forms, CRM records, etc.) that a non-technical ops user could wire up. There is no evidence of any connected-app trigger/connector ecosystem for ops users; starting a workflow always requires a developer to write client/signal code.
